description: List the ready-made fixes Website Auditor can serve finished for a tracked site, top first: whether each is needed and why, whether the platform the site runs on can take it, and its newest request with that request's status (live, missing, or not checked yet). Use this when someone asks which fixes their site needs, which to do first, or whether a fix they added has gone live. Also returns the site's detected `platform`, the `platforms` a fix's steps can be written for, and each newest request's `id`, which check_fix takes, without recording a new request. Reads only: nothing is recorded and the site is not fetched. It answers only for a site the account tracks. Requires a Website Auditor subscription ($49/month; eligible new customers get a 7-day free trial — payment method required, no charge until the trial ends) — if the user doesn't have one, call get_sample_audit first to show them the exact output format, free and with no API key.
name: list_fixes

id.description: The request's id: what a live check of this fix takes.

path.description: How it was asked for: "served" (the dashboard), "mcp" or "api".

status.description: "live", "missing", or null before a check reached the site.

request.description: The fix's newest request, or null when it was never asked for.

platform.description: The platform detected for the site ("unknown" when none was).

platforms.description: The platforms a fix's steps can be written for.

top.description: The top fix's kind, or null when none is needed that the site's platform can take.

title: List ready-made fixes
